mainEntity.name: Can I create my own consent form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester's consent form generator gives you three starting points: a prompt-to-form AI, a paper PDF upload that gets digitized in one click, or a template gallery of 25+ vetted consent forms. Every route ends in a form you can share via link, embed on your site, or send by email.

mainEntity.name: Is the consent form generator really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Unlimited forms and unlimited signed submissions on the free plan, with the native e-signature field included. No trial that expires, no card required at signup, no cap on how many consents you collect.

mainEntity.name: Can I export the signed consent as a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, on Business and above. Every signed submission renders as a formatted PDF with the signer identity block, the exact consent language they agreed to, the signature drawn or typed, and a UTC timestamp. Free and Personal tiers still capture the same data, the PDF export is the layer that lets you share the signed record with legal, HR, or a client.

mainEntity.name: Is Formester's electronic signature legally valid?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the vast majority of consent workflows in the US, UK, EU, Canada, and Australia, yes. E-signatures are recognized under ESIGN and UETA in the US, eIDAS in the EU and UK, and PIPEDA in Canada, as long as three conditions are met: the signer clearly agreed, the signature is attributable to them, and the record is preserved. Formester captures intent via checkbox plus signature act, attribution via signer identity plus timestamp, and preservation via encrypted storage plus PDF export.

mainEntity.name: Can I use this for research participant consent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes for behavioral research, user studies, surveys, and product interviews. Add your IRB-approved consent language to the form, capture the signature, export as PDF for the IRB record. For research involving PHI under HIPAA, use a HIPAA-eligible tool like Jotform Gold since Formester is not HIPAA-certified.

mainEntity.name: Does Formester handle GDPR and CCPA compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester is GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. EU data residency is available on Business and above. The form itself can be structured with granular opt-in unbundling, separate checkboxes for marketing, analytics, and third-party sharing, so the consent you capture matches GDPR Recital 32.

mainEntity.name: How is this different from a Google Forms consent form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Forms lets you build a consent form, but it does not have a native e-signature field. Respondents can type their name into a text box, which is not a signature. Formester's signature field captures a drawn or typed signature, signer identity, and timestamp on every submission, then exports to PDF on Business and above.

mainEntity.name: Can I add my own logo and branding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Personal at 12 dollars per month yearly removes Formester branding and adds a custom URL slug. Business at 45 dollars per month yearly adds a custom domain like consent.yourbrand.com plus full logo and color customization.

mainEntity.name: What are the 4 types of consent?

acceptedAnswer.text: In legal and healthcare frameworks, consent typically falls into four categories: implied (assumed from the person's actions or situation), express (given explicitly, verbally or in writing), informed (given after the person has been given all material facts), and specific (limited to a defined purpose or transaction). Formester's consent form generator is designed for express, informed, and specific consent workflows where a written record is required.

components.markup:
How it works

Three ways to build your consent form

Pick whichever start point fits how you work. Every route ends in a shareable form that captures a legally valid e-signature with each submission.

Start from a template

Pick from 25+ consent form templates: photo release, GDPR marketing opt-in, background check consent, participant research consent, event waiver. Swap the copy, adjust the fields, publish.

Best when the language is standard and you need something legal-clean fast.

Generate with AI

Prompt: "Consent form for a Q4 photo shoot where the model releases image rights for social media." Or paste your own paragraph. Our AI picks the field types, wires the signature block, and ships in 30 seconds.

Digitize your paper PDF

Upload the paper consent form you already have. Our AI reads the PDF, extracts every field, and rebuilds it as a digital form with a native e-signature slot at the bottom. Two clicks to modernize a 10-year-old paper process.

Signature validity

Every signed consent stands up later

An e-signature that gets challenged is only as good as what's captured around it. A signature image alone is not enough. Courts and auditors look for the signer's identity, the exact time it was signed, and evidence the signer had reasonable notice of what they were consenting to.

Formester's signature field captures all of that on every submission, on every plan including free. Drawn on a mouse, trackpad, or finger, or typed in the signer's own hand. Stored encrypted at rest and available as a PDF export on Business and above. GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. Legally valid for the vast majority of consent workflows in the US, UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

What gets captured on every submission

Five layers of proof, on by default

  • Native e-signature drawn or typed, stored as a vector alongside the raw signature image.
  • Signer identity captured alongside the signature: full name, email, and any other fields you added.
  • Exact timestamp down to the second, in UTC, on every signature.
  • PDF export of every signed consent, on Business and above, so records can be shared with legal, HR, or a client.
  • GDPR, UK GDPR, CCPA compliant storage. Encryption at rest and in transit. We never share or train on your consent data (DPA §4.4).

components.markup:
See it happen

Watch a consent form build itself

Type the prompt, click generate, and the form is ready to edit and share.

Who uses our consent form generator

Teams that need signed consent to move forward, in industries where the signature has to hold up.

Marketing teams

Photo release forms for shoot subjects. GDPR-compliant marketing opt-in for newsletter and campaign lists. Testimonial usage consent from happy customers.

HR and People teams

Background check consent from new hires. Payroll deduction authorization. Photo and video release for internal company use. Reference check consent from candidates.

Legal and compliance

Event liability waivers, engagement letters, non-disclosure acknowledgements, click-to-agree terms. Every signed record ships with signer identity plus a UTC timestamp on the same submission.

Generate Quizzes in Seconds →

Clinicians (non-PHI use only)

Formester is not HIPAA-certified. For PHI intake use Jotform Gold or Cognito Forms Enterprise. For non-PHI consent inside a clinical practice, marketing opt-in, patient education acknowledgements, event RSVPs, and photo releases, Formester fits.

Researchers

Participant informed-consent for survey studies, user interviews, and product research. Capture the signed consent alongside the study screener in one submission.

Analyze Customer Feedback →

Schools and colleges

Field trip permission slips, media release for student photos, athletics participation waivers, technology use agreements. Parent name and student name captured on the same signed submission.

Generate Surveys with AI in Seconds →

Event organizers

Liability waivers for attendees, photo and video release for the event coverage, allergen and dietary consent for catered events, minor participation forms with parent signature.

Nonprofits

Volunteer liability waivers, donor recognition consent for annual reports, program participation acknowledgements. Free plan handles unlimited signed consents at $0.

For developers

Your submissions, ready for the CRM you already use

Every Formester form ships with a REST API and an MCP server, so submissions don't stop at a CSV. Pipe leads into your agent. Stream applications into your hiring copilot. Nobody else on this list ships MCP.

MCP server

Plug Formester into Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible model

Claude ChatGPT Custom agents

Connect Formester to any MCP-compatible model and let it read your signed consent records directly. Ask Claude "which participant consents from this week's study need follow-up?" or have a custom agent flag any consent submission where the signer opted out of specific data uses so your ops team can act on it.

Read the MCP docs →
REST API v2

Or build directly on the REST API

Self-service token Webhooks Business plan +

Pull signed consent records into your CRM or data warehouse, log the timestamp to your compliance system, or push pre-filled consent URLs back from Salesforce. Self-service token at app.formester.com/api in two clicks. No support ticket, no waiting.

Read the API docs →

Privacy and data ownership

Your consent records belong to you. We don't train on them

When you upload a PDF, paste a prompt, or generate a form, that content is used to generate your form and nothing else. Per Section 4.4 of our DPA, Formester does not use Customer Data for analytics, advertising, marketing, or product training. The Google Gemini integration we use to power AI features inherits the same boundary.

Encrypted in transit and at rest, hosted on Heroku and AWS, automated encrypted backups with a 90-day retention, and full data deletion on request. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified yet, and we will tell you so directly rather than dance around it.

What's in the DPA
"Formester does not use Customer Data for analytics, advertising, marketing, or product training."

Section 4.4, Formester Data Processing Agreement, effective January 2026.
